first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify the archived record before committing to assess whether gains reflected qualified, durable revenue rather than discount-driven volume, and begin with a guarded segment-level test because retention and long-term value effects remain uncertain.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline, while inherited evidence links shorter onboarding and simpler signup to durable activation and faster time-to-value. Reject promotional pricing because the verified source shows 12% lower 30-day retention and explicitly warns against treating the tactic as sustainable growth. Measure qualified activation and retained revenue, not completion alone, because the onboarding evidence does not yet establish long-term revenue impact in the current cohort.
